example: The quality of the final report leaves much to be desired.

examples.en: The quality of the final report leaves much to be desired.
examples.zh: 最終報告的質素很不理想。
examples.highlight: The quality of the final report leaves much to be desired.

rules.zh: 必須配合主語和時態這項設計很不理想。 這些設施很不理想。 這項服務當時很不理想。 維修工作的質素一直未如理想。
rules.en: Leave The design leaves much to be desired. The facilities leave much to be desired. The service left much to be desired. The repairs have left much to be desired.

rules.zh: 使用 much，不使用 many 以【Much】為例：在這裏表示「很多仍未達到理想的地方」。
rules.en: The service leaves much to be desired. The service leaves many to be desired.

rules.zh: 固定部分是 to be desired，不可改成 to desire、to be desiring 或 to have desired；整個結構表示實際表現仍未達理想水平。
rules.en: to desire to be desiring to have desired The result leaves much to be desired.

rules.zh: 這是一個相當強烈但較含蓄的批評這句比：【The report is terrible.】 語氣較克制和專業，但仍然表示報告存在明顯問題。
rules.en: The report leaves much to be desired. The report is terrible.

rules.zh: 主語通常是事物、表現、質素或處理方式常見主語包括：【the service；the quality；the arrangements；the design；the explanation；the results；the way something was handled】 直接用一個人作主語有時會顯得過分籠統或針對個人。較清楚的寫法是指出其具體表現：【His attitude leaves much to be desired.】 他的態度很不理想。 他與顧客溝通的方式很不理想。 第二句更加具體。
rules.en: the service the quality the arrangements the design the explanation the results the way something was handled His attitude leaves much to be desired. The way he communicates with customers leaves much to be desired.

rules.zh: 目標表達【A lot to be desired】是常見變體，但本課不使用這句在日常英語中很常見，但本練習統一使用：【leave much to be desired】
rules.en: A lot to be desired The service leaves a lot to be desired. leave much to be desired

rules.zh: 目標表達【Leaves nothing to be desired】表示相反意思這項服務無可挑剔。 這與本課所學的意思相反，因此不包括在答案中。
rules.en: Leaves nothing to be desired The service leaves nothing to be desired.

benefits.zh: 這個句型讓你以較克制的方式提出批評。你不需要直接說某事物「非常差」，也能清楚指出它有明顯不足。第二句仍然是負面評價，但更加適合報告、評論、電郵及正式討論。
benefits.en: It lets you criticise something in a controlled way. Instead of using a blunt sentence such as “The report is terrible”, you can give strong criticism in a more measured form. Compare: The report is terrible. The report leaves much to be desired.

benefits.zh: 當某件事有多項不足時，你可以先用這個句型作整體評價，不必立即逐一列出所有問題。活動安排有很多不足之處。 之後可以再補充場地、時間安排、設備或溝通方面的問題。
benefits.en: It summarises several weaknesses at once. You can use the expression when something has a number of problems but you do not need to list every problem immediately. The organisation of the event left much to be desired.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以讓你先承認優點，再指出不足，使評論更加平衡。雖然酒店位置方便，但其顧客服務很不理想。
benefits.en: It helps you balance praise and criticism. You can recognise a positive point before identifying the weaker aspect. Although the hotel is conveniently located, its customer service leaves much to be desired.

benefits.zh: 這個句型很適合用於產品評論、工作報告、學術評語、顧客投訴及專業反饋。
benefits.en: It is useful in reviews, reports and professional feedback. The expression can describe weak quality, poor performance, inadequate planning or unsatisfactory service.

benefits.zh: 這個固定說法可以配合簡單句、問句、從句、引述句及焦點句式，讓學生不必反覆使用完全相同的句子排列。
benefits.en: It gives you several sentence-building choices. The fixed expression can appear in simple sentences, questions, subordinate clauses, reporting structures and focus structures.

questions.answer: If the final version continues to leave much to be desired, the board will reject it.
questions.answerZh: 如果最終版本仍然有明顯不足，董事會便會拒絕它。
questions.highlight: If the final version continues to leave much to be desired, the board will reject it.

questions.prompt: The service was so unsatisfactory that several long-term customers cancelled their accounts.
questions.promptZh: 這項服務非常不理想，以致數名長期顧客取消了戶口。
questions.answer: Because the service left much to be desired, several long-term customers cancelled their accounts.
questions.answerZh: 由於這項服務很不理想，數名長期顧客取消了戶口。
questions.highlight: Because the service left much to be desired, several long-term customers cancelled their accounts.

questions.prompt: The revised safety plan is still inadequate in several important areas, so it should not yet be approved.

questions.prompt: The audit found major weaknesses in record-keeping, staff training and data security.
questions.promptZh: 審計發現，檔案管理、員工培訓和數據保安均存在重大不足。
questions.answer: According to the audit, record-keeping, staff training and data security all left much to be desired.
questions.answerZh: 根據審計結果，檔案管理、員工培訓和數據保安均存在重大不足。
questions.highlight: According to the audit, record-keeping, staff training and data security all left much to be desired.

questions.prompt: Although the project met its deadline and budget, its long-term planning, risk control and public communication were all unsatisfactory.
questions.promptZh: 雖然項目按時完成並符合預算，但其長遠規劃、風險控制和公眾溝通均不理想。
questions.answer: Despite meeting its deadline and budget, the project still left much to be desired in long-term planning, risk control and public communication.
